Ethanol RINs Lower and Ethanol Cash Prices Higher Friday

Ethanol RINs were lower and ethanol cash prices were higher Friday. December corn closed down 3 3/4 cents per bushel at $4.74 1/4 and March closed down 4 1/2 cents at $4.86 1/2.
